rows.summary:
The CSO-203 Relocation Project involves relocating an aging combined sewer overflow (CSO) culvert currently located beneath the E. 55th Street Marina in Cleveland that discharges to Lake Erie.

  • The project site is located at the East 55th Street Marina in the City of Cleveland. The project will also take place on ODOT property near the entrance and exit ramps for Interstat

rows.summary: The purpose of this bid, and the requirement contract awarded following an evaluation of the bids received, is to provide rubbish removal and single-stream recycling collection and disposal services at specified Northeast Ohio Regional Sewer District locations.
